work: A Family Well-Ordered. Or An Essay to Render Parents and Children Happy in One A
heading: Title Page

items.text: Promote piety in your children.
items.citation: Mather, A Family Well-Ordered, Title Page
items.quote: the Duties to be done by Pious Parents, for the promoting of Piety in their Children

items.text: Pay your parents the duties you owe them, that you may obtain the blessings of the dutiful.
items.citation: Mather, A Family Well-Ordered, Title Page
items.quote: the Duties that must be paid by Children to their Parents, that they may obtain the Blessings of the Dutiful

work: A Family Well-Ordered. Or An Essay to Render Parents and Children Happy in One A
heading: THE Duties of CHILDREN To their Parents.

items.text: Do not treat your father or mother with contempt; honor them, for God's curse rests on the child who sets light by either of them.
items.citation: Family Well-Ordered, Duties of Children
items.quote: Cursed is he that setteth Light, by his Father or his Mother.

items.text: Do not despise your mother, even if her fondness or weakness makes her seem contemptible; the curse of God falls on that contempt.
items.citation: Family Well-Ordered, Duties of Children
items.quote: The children which cast Contempt upon their Mothers, do also bring themselves under the Curse of God.

work: A Family Well-Ordered. Or An Essay to Render Parents and Children Happy in One A
heading: THE Duties of PARENTS To their Children. … CASE.

items.text: Command them to keep the way of the Lord.
items.citation: A Family Well-Ordered, THE Duties of PARENTS To their Children. … CASE.
items.quote: I know him, that he will command his Children and his Houshold after him, and they shall keep the way of the Lord.

items.text: Teach your servants the way of the Lord as you do your children.
items.citation: A Family Well-Ordered, THE Duties of PARENTS To their Children. … CASE.
items.quote: Our whole Houshold, as well as the Children that are our Offspring, are to be taught the Way of the Lord.

items.text: Walk in the way of the Lord yourself, that you may faithfully bring up your children in it.
items.citation: A Family Well-Ordered, THE Duties of PARENTS To their Children. … CASE.
items.quote: If you don't first become your selves Pious, you'l do nothing to purpose to make your Children so.

work: A Family Well-Ordered. Or An Essay to Render Parents and Children Happy in One A
heading: THE Duties of PARENTS To their Children. · Counsel

items.text: Endeavor their salvation above all; be more solicitous for their souls than for their bodies.
items.citation: A Family Well-Ordered, Counsel
items.quote: You should be more sollicitous that their Souls may not be Starved, or go without the Bread of Life.

items.text: When you bring them to baptism, do not do it as an empty formality, but give them to the Lord, as Hannah did, and take hold of the covenant for them.
items.citation: A Family Well-Ordered, Counsel
items.quote: I have given this Child unto the Lord, as long as he Lives he shall be given unto the Lord.

work: A Family Well-Ordered. Or An Essay to Render Parents and Children Happy in One A
heading: An Address, Ad Fratres in Eremo.

items.text: See to it that your children are sent to school and well educated.
items.citation: A Family Well-Ordered, An Address, Ad Fratres in Eremo
items.quote: can they be well Educated, if their Parents never send them to SCHOOL?

work: A Family Well-Ordered. Or An Essay to Render Parents and Children Happy in One A
heading: THE Duties of CHILDREN To their Parents. · CASE.

items.text: Honor and respect your parents; do not set light by them or treat them with contempt.
items.citation: A Family Well-Ordered, Duties of Children to their Parents, Case
items.quote: put not Respect, but Contempt, upon their Parents

items.text: Obey your parents; do not be disobedient to them.
items.citation: A Family Well-Ordered, Duties of Children to their Parents, Case
items.quote: Disobedient unto Parents

items.text: Heed the advice of your parents and do not cast contempt upon it.
items.citation: A Family Well-Ordered, Duties of Children to their Parents, Case
items.quote: the Contempt which they cast upon the Advice of their Parents

items.text: Provide for your parents from your estate; do what you can for them.
items.citation: A Family Well-Ordered, Duties of Children to their Parents, Case
items.quote: being Lothe to do what they could for their Parents, with their Estates

items.text: Do not reproach or despise your parents.
items.citation: A Family Well-Ordered, Duties of Children to their Parents, Case
items.quote: They have Reproached or Despised their Parents.

items.text: Do not marry without your parents' consent, lest you cast contempt upon them.
items.citation: A Family Well-Ordered, Duties of Children to their Parents, Case
items.quote: cast Contempt upon his Parents, by Marrying a Canaanitess, as it should seem without their Consent

items.text: Do not curse your children or call down imprecations upon them.
items.citation: A Family Well-Ordered, Duties of Children to their Parents, Case
items.quote: forbear to use any Imprecations on your Children.

work: A Family Well-Ordered. Or An Essay to Render Parents and Children Happy in One A
heading: THE Duties of PARENTS To their Children. · Counsel

items.text: Tell them what their baptism signified and why they were baptized.
items.citation: A Family Well-Ordered, The Duties of Parents to their Children, Counsel
items.quote: make them understand, what the Design of their Baptism was.

items.text: Bring them up for the Lord Jesus Christ.
items.citation: A Family Well-Ordered, The Duties of Parents to their Children, Counsel
items.quote: bring it up for the Lord Jesus Christ, I charge you.

items.text: Let them know they were dedicated to Christ in baptism and enlisted as his servants and soldiers.
items.citation: A Family Well-Ordered, The Duties of Parents to their Children, Counsel
items.quote: They were Listed among the Servants and Souldiers of the Lord Jesus Christ.

items.text: Show them from Scripture the obligations of their baptism: obey all Christ commanded, be dead to sin, put on Christ, answer with good conscience.
items.citation: A Family Well-Ordered, The Duties of Parents to their Children, Counsel
items.quote: from Mat. 28.19, 20... they must observe all Things, whatsoever the Lord Jesus Christ has Commanded them.

items.text: Urge them to answer the covenant: accept God as Father, Son, and Spirit, and be his servant.
items.citation: A Family Well-Ordered, The Duties of Parents to their Children, Counsel
items.quote: Shall God the Father, be thy Father? Shall God the Son, be thy Saviour! Shall God the Spirit, be thy Sanctifier; And art thou willing to be the Servant of that one God?

items.text: Instruct them in the great matters of salvation; do not let them die without instruction.
items.citation: A Family Well-Ordered, The Duties of Parents to their Children, Counsel
items.quote: don't let them Dy without Instruction.

work: A Family Well-Ordered. Or An Essay to Render Parents and Children Happy in One A
heading: THE Duties of CHILDREN To their Parents. · CASE.

items.text: Reverence them in your heart: see God's image and authority in their superiority over you.
items.citation: A Family Well-Ordered, Duties of Children to their Parents, CASE
items.quote: The God of Nature hath placed a Distance, between Parents and their Children; Children then Set Light by their Parents, when they Forget this Distance.

items.text: Speak to them and of them with such reverence that nothing abusive is ever uttered.
items.citation: A Family Well-Ordered, Duties of Children to their Parents, CASE
items.quote: Their Speeches, both to their Parents, & of their Parents, must be full of Reverence.

items.text: Show outward reverence in your actions: bow before them and rise to meet them.
items.citation: A Family Well-Ordered, Duties of Children to their Parents, CASE
items.quote: Joseph bowed himself, with his Face to the Earth, before his Father.

items.text: Defend your father from false accusers and enemies.
items.citation: A Family Well-Ordered, Duties of Children to their Parents, CASE
items.quote: The Children of Youth, seem to Defend their Father, from the Enemies in the Gate, or, False-Accusers.

items.text: Obey your parents in the Lord, counting their will as a law to you.
items.citation: A Family Well-Ordered, Duties of Children to their Parents, CASE
items.quote: Children, Obey your Parents in the Lord, for this is Right.

items.text: Hear the instruction of a father and receive his reproofs.
items.citation: A Family Well-Ordered, Duties of Children to their Parents, CASE
items.quote: Hear, ye Children, the Instruction of a Father.

items.text: Consult your parents and seek their satisfaction in your calling and marriage.
items.citation: A Family Well-Ordered, Duties of Children to their Parents, CASE
items.quote: In your Callings, and in your Matches especially, the Directions of your Parents must be of Exceeding Moment with you.

items.text: Do not leave undone what they desire, and do not do what they forbid.
items.citation: A Family Well-Ordered, Duties of Children to their Parents, CASE
items.quote: You Set Light by them, if you Leave Undone what they Desire, and much more, if you Do what they Forbid.

items.text: Requite your parents: support them in age and need, and do not forsake your mother when she is old.
items.citation: A Family Well-Ordered, Duties of Children to their Parents, CASE
items.quote: Let the Children Learn to show piety at home, and Requite their Parents; for that is Good and Acceptable before God.

items.text: Do not wrong, rob, or waste your parents' substance; support them instead.
items.citation: A Family Well-Ordered, Duties of Children to their Parents, CASE
items.quote: Some there are who do not Support their Parents, but Wrong them, and Rob them, and Pillage them; They Wast their Parents.

work: A Family Well-Ordered. Or An Essay to Render Parents and Children Happy in One A
heading: THE Duties of CHILDREN To their Parents. · CASE.

items.text: Reverence your parents: give them the honor due to them.
items.citation: A Family Well-Ordered, Duties of Children to Their Parents, Case
items.quote: Reverence, and, Obedience, and Recompence.

items.text: Obey your parents.
items.citation: A Family Well-Ordered, Duties of Children to Their Parents, Case
items.quote: Those Reckabites, that Obey the Commandment of their Father

items.text: Repay them: support them in their need, especially when aged.
items.citation: A Family Well-Ordered, Duties of Children to Their Parents, Case
items.quote: supported their Aged Parents, in their Necessities

items.text: Be a blessing to your parents: make them glad by your wisdom and character.
items.citation: A Family Well-Ordered, Duties of Children to Their Parents, Case
items.quote: Be Blessings to your Parents

items.text: Do not treat your parents lightly or with contempt.
items.citation: A Family Well-Ordered, Duties of Children to Their Parents, Case
items.quote: Set not Light by your Parents

items.text: Pray and desire that you may be made a rich blessing to your parents.
items.citation: A Family Well-Ordered, Duties of Children to Their Parents, Case
items.quote: their continual Desire and Prayer it is, That they may be in all Things made Rich Blessings unto their Parents

work: A Family Well-Ordered. Or An Essay to Render Parents and Children Happy in One A
heading: THE Duties of PARENTS To their Children. · Counsel

items.text: Keep up so much authority that your word may be a law unto them.
items.citation: A Family Well-Ordered, The Duties of Parents to their Children · Counsel
items.quote: keep up so much Authority, that your Word may be a Law unto them.

items.text: Temper your authority with kindness, meekness, and loving tenderness, so that they may fear you with delight and see that you love them.
items.citation: A Family Well-Ordered, The Duties of Parents to their Children · Counsel
items.quote: Our Authority should be so Tempered with Kindness, and Meekness, and Loving Tenderness, that our Children may Fear us with Delight

items.text: Interpose your authority to stop and check them when they run into the paths of the Destroyer.
items.citation: A Family Well-Ordered, The Duties of Parents to their Children · Counsel
items.quote: Interpose your Authority, to stop and check the Carrier of your Children, when they will be running into the paths of the Destroyer.

items.text: Keep a strict inspection upon their conversations; examine how they spend their time, what company they keep, and whether they take bad courses.
items.citation: A Family Well-Ordered, The Duties of Parents to their Children · Counsel
items.quote: Keep a strict Inspection upon their Conversations; Examine, How they spend their Time? Examine, What Company they keep? Examine, Whether they take no Bad Courses?

items.text: When you find out their miscarriages, effectually rebuke and restrain them.
items.citation: A Family Well-Ordered, The Duties of Parents to their Children · Counsel
items.quote: When you Find out their Miscarriages, effectually Rebuke them, and Restrain them.

items.text: Chasten them with the rod when needed, but never give a blow in passion; let them see you do it out of obedience to God and for their true repentance.
items.citation: A Family Well-Ordered, The Duties of Parents to their Children · Counsel
items.quote: Never give a Blow in a passion. Stay till your passion is over; and let the Offendors plainly see, that you deal thus with them, out of pure Obedience unto God

items.text: Reward them when they do well, but do not gratify every ungodly vanity they set their minds on.
items.citation: A Family Well-Ordered, The Duties of Parents to their Children · Counsel
items.quote: Gratify them with Rewards of Well-doing, when they Do well; but let them not be gratified with every Ungodly Vanity

items.text: Charge them to work about their own salvation.
items.citation: A Family Well-Ordered, The Duties of Parents to their Children · Counsel
items.quote: Parents, Charge them to Work about their own Salvation.

items.text: Charge them to believe on the Lord Jesus Christ and to carry their poor guilty souls to him for salvation.
items.citation: A Family Well-Ordered, The Duties of Parents to their Children · Counsel
items.quote: Charge them to carry their poor, guilty, ignorant and polluted and Enslaved Souls, unto the Lord Jesus Christ, that He may Save them

items.text: Charge them to set apart time for consideration, to consider their ways and their eternal state.
items.citation: A Family Well-Ordered, The Duties of Parents to their Children · Counsel
items.quote: Charge them to set apart a few minutes now and then, for Consideration

work: A Family Well-Ordered. Or An Essay to Render Parents and Children Happy in One A
heading: THE Duties of PARENTS To their Children. · Counsel

items.text: Charge your children to retire for secret prayer every day, and teach them what to pray for.
items.citation: A Family Well-Ordered, Counsel
items.quote: Charge them to Retire for Secret Prayer, every Day that comes over their Heads.

items.text: Charge them to forsake the foolish and live, and to avoid evil company as they would the plague or the devil.
items.citation: A Family Well-Ordered, Counsel
items.quote: Charge them to avoid the snares of Evil Company; Terrify them with Warnings of those Deadly Snares.

items.text: Command your children not to forsake the holy institutions of Christ and to worship God only as he has appointed.
items.citation: A Family Well-Ordered, Counsel
items.quote: Command your Children, That they don't Forsake the Holy Institutions of the Lord Jesus Christ, and Embrace a Vain Worship, consisting of Things that He never Instituted.

items.text: Keep charging your children while you live, and at death speak solemnly to them about coming to Christ.
items.citation: A Family Well-Ordered, Counsel
items.quote: Thus keep Charging of your Children, while you Live. And, if you are capable so to Do, Do it once more with all possible Solemnity, when you come to Dy.

items.text: Be an example to your children in word, conduct, love, spirit, faith, and purity, so they can follow you as you follow Christ.
items.citation: A Family Well-Ordered, Counsel
items.quote: Be thou an Example in Word, in Conversation, in Charity, in Spirit, in Faith, in Purity.

items.text: Pray daily for the salvation of each child by name, with importunity and fasting if needed, until God blesses.
items.citation: A Family Well-Ordered, Counsel
items.quote: carry the Names of every one of them, every day before the Lord, with Prayers, the Cries whereof shall pierce the very Heavens.

items.text: Maintain family prayer with your children, lest your family be pagan and your children be lost.
items.citation: A Family Well-Ordered, Counsel
items.quote: Family prayer must be maintained by all those Parents, that would not have their Children miss of Salvation.

items.text: Take each capable child aside alone, kneel with them, and pour out your soul to God for their salvation.
items.citation: A Family Well-Ordered, Counsel
items.quote: take one capable Child after another, alone before the Lord? Carry the Child with you, into your Secret Chambers; make the Child kneel down by you

items.text: Mothers, give the law of God to your children, watch over their ways, and travail in prayer for their salvation.
items.citation: A Family Well-Ordered, Counsel
items.quote: a Mother must give the Law of God unto them. ... Do you Travail for your Children over again, with your Earnest Prayers for their Salvation.

work: A Family Well-Ordered. Or An Essay to Render Parents and Children Happy in One A
heading: THE Duties of CHILDREN To their Parents. · CASE.

items.text: Honor your father and your mother.
items.citation: A Family Well-Ordered, Duties of Children to their Parents, CASE
items.quote: Honour thy Father and thy Mother, that thy Dayes may be long upon the Land.

items.text: Do not set light by your father or mother.
items.citation: A Family Well-Ordered, Duties of Children to their Parents, CASE
items.quote: Your Dayes are not like to be long upon the Land, if you Set Light by your Father, or Mother.

items.text: Obey your father and mother.
items.citation: A Family Well-Ordered, Duties of Children to their Parents, CASE
items.quote: despises to obey his Mother

items.text: Do not curse your father or mother.
items.citation: A Family Well-Ordered, Duties of Children to their Parents, CASE
items.quote: He that curseth his Father or his Mother, shall surely be put unto Death.

items.text: Do not mock your father.
items.citation: A Family Well-Ordered, Duties of Children to their Parents, CASE
items.quote: The Eye that mocks at his Father

items.text: Be a comfort to your parents.
items.citation: A Family Well-Ordered, Duties of Children to their Parents, CASE
items.quote: It becomes Children to reckon it one main Design, and Business, and priviledge of their Life, to be Comforts unto their Parents

items.text: Do not rebel against your father.
items.citation: A Family Well-Ordered, Duties of Children to their Parents, CASE
items.quote: Thus it shall be done unto the Son that Rebelleth against his Father.

items.text: Be dutiful to your parents.
items.citation: A Family Well-Ordered, Duties of Children to their Parents, CASE
items.quote: Be Dutiful to thy Parents, or expect all the formidable outpourings of an Infinite and Eternal Wrath upon thy Soul

items.text: Do not cast contempt on your parents.
items.citation: A Family Well-Ordered, Duties of Children to their Parents, CASE
items.quote: Children that cast Contempt on the Parents

work: A Family Well-Ordered. Or An Essay to Render Parents and Children Happy in One A
heading: THE Duties of CHILDREN To their Parents. · CASE.

items.text: Do not set light by your father or mother; give them the honor they are due.
items.citation: A Family Well-Ordered, Duties of Children 5
items.quote: Cursed is he that Sets Light by his Father or his Mother.

items.text: Be subject to your parents as the Lord Jesus was subject to his earthly parents.
items.citation: A Family Well-Ordered, Duties of Children 5
items.quote: He went down with His Mother, and His Reputed Father, and though they were very Low, in the World, He became subject unto them.

items.text: Provide for a widowed parent, taking them into your home and care.
items.citation: A Family Well-Ordered, Duties of Children 5
items.quote: That His Widow Mother, might be provided for: He said unto a Disciple, Behold, thy Mother!

items.text: Hear your parents' instruction and obey all their commands that are not sinful; do not make light of their admonitions.
items.citation: A Family Well-Ordered, Duties of Children 6
items.quote: My Son, Hear the Instruction of thy Father, and forsake not the Law of thy Mother.

items.text: Do not grieve your parents by ungodly and vain living; turn to God in Christ and become devout, so that they may rejoice in you.
items.citation: A Family Well-Ordered, Duties of Children 6
items.quote: Give, Give some Relief to this Grief of your Parents... Turn to God in Christ, and become Devout Children.

work: A Family Well-Ordered. Or An Essay to Render Parents and Children Happy in One A
heading: THE Duties of PARENTS To their Children. · Counsel

items.text: Teach your children to read, write, and cipher, and set them to useful callings; teach daughters as well as sons the things that will make them useful in their places.
items.citation: Family Well-Ordered, Duties of Parents to their Children, Counsel
items.quote: They should Read, and Write, and Cyphar, and be put unto some Agreeable Callings; and not only our Sons, but our Daughters also should be taught such Things.

items.text: Instruct your children in the articles of religion; acquaint them with God, Christ, the mysteries of the gospel, and the doctrines and methods of salvation.
items.citation: Family Well-Ordered, Duties of Parents to their Children, Counsel
items.quote: Parents, Instruct your Children, in the Articles of Religion; and acquaint them, with God, and Christ, and the Mysteries of the Gospel, and the Doctrines and Methods of Salvation.

items.text: Bring up your children in the nurture and admonition of the Lord.
items.citation: Family Well-Ordered, Duties of Parents to their Children, Counsel
items.quote: Fathers, bring up your Children in the Nurture and Admonition of the Lord.

items.text: Cause your children to look often into their Bibles, and single out special sentences from Scripture for them to memorize.
items.citation: Family Well-Ordered, Duties of Parents to their Children, Counsel
items.quote: Cause them to look often into their Bibles, and here and there Single out some special Sentences from those Oracles of Heaven for them to get into their memories.

items.text: See that they learn their catechism perfectly, and do not be content with rote answers; question them distinctly on every clause so that the truth enters their souls.
items.citation: Family Well-Ordered, Duties of Parents to their Children, Counsel
items.quote: Be sure, that they Learn their Catechism very perfectly; But then content not your selves with hearing them say by Rote, the Answers in their Catechism.

items.text: After they come home from the ministry, apply it to them; confer with them about the things handled, go over them until they have clear ideas, and then direct them to avoid evil, do good, and pray accordingly.
items.citation: Family Well-Ordered, Duties of Parents to their Children, Counsel
items.quote: what they hear in the Evangelical Ministry, do you Apply it unto them after their coming Home; Confer with them about the Things that have been handled in the Ministry

items.text: Watch all opportunities to instill instruction into your little ones; they are narrow-mouthed vessels, so drop it in little by little.
items.citation: Family Well-Ordered, Duties of Parents to their Children, Counsel
items.quote: watch all opportunities, to be instilling your Instructions into the Souls or your little Folks, They are narrow-mouth'd Vessels, and things must be drop after drop instill'd into them.

items.text: Teach God’s words diligently to your children; talk of them when you sit at home, walk by the way, lie down, and rise up.
items.citation: Family Well-Ordered, Duties of Parents to their Children, Counsel
items.quote: Thou shalt teach them Diligently unto thy Children, and shalt Talk of them, when thou sittest in thine House, and when thou walkest by the way

items.text: When you are with your children, say some profitable thing for them to think upon—something of God, Christ, another world, their souls, sins that endanger them, and ways to be happy.
items.citation: Family Well-Ordered, Duties of Parents to their Children, Counsel
items.quote: There is nothing to hinder our saying some profitable Thing for them to think upon; Well, can you let fall Nothing upon them, that it will be worth their while

items.text: Train up a child in the way he should go, so that when he is old he will not depart from it.
items.citation: Family Well-Ordered, Duties of Parents to their Children, Counsel
items.quote: Train up a Child in the way he should go, and when he is old, he will not Depart from it.

items.text: With sweet authority rebuke your children for, and restrain them from, everything that may harm their salvation.
items.citation: Family Well-Ordered, Duties of Parents to their Children, Counsel
items.quote: Parents, With a Sweet Authority over your Children, Rebuke them for, and Restrain them from, every thing that may prove prejudicial unto their Salvation.

work: A Family Well-Ordered. Or An Essay to Render Parents and Children Happy in One A
heading: THE Duties of CHILDREN To their Parents. · CASE.

items.text: Set not light by any kind of parent; God will curse the children that set light by them.
items.citation: Family Well-Ordered, Duties of Children to their Parents, CASE
items.quote: Natural Parents cannot safely come into the Contempt of their Children: God will Curse the Children that Set Light by Them.

items.text: Be subject to your masters with all fear, not only to the good and gentle but also to the froward.
items.citation: Family Well-Ordered, Duties of Children to their Parents, CASE
items.quote: Servants, be subject unto your Masters, with all Fear, not only to the Good & Gentle, but also to the Froward.

items.text: Do not set light by your master or mistress; expose not their failings; show no sullenness, sauciness, or rude retortings.
items.citation: Family Well-Ordered, Duties of Children to their Parents, CASE
items.quote: Do not Set Light by thy Master, or thy Mistress. Expose not their Failings, if you see any in them. Let there be no Sullenness, no Sawciness, no Rude Retortings.

items.text: Answer when your master calls; do not give him cause to complain that you gave no answer.
items.citation: Family Well-Ordered, Duties of Children to their Parents, CASE
items.quote: Give them not cause to complain, with Job, I called my Servant, and he gave me no Answer.

items.text: Do not be an eye-servant, working only when your master watches; work heartily as unto the Lord.
items.citation: Family Well-Ordered, Duties of Children to their Parents, CASE
items.quote: Be not those Eye Servants, that will do their Masters Will, no longer then their Masters Eye is upon them.

items.text: Transgress not your master's just commands; if he bids you do an ill thing, refuse with modest expostulations rather than obey.
items.citation: Family Well-Ordered, Duties of Children to their Parents, CASE
items.quote: Transgress not their just Commands... if your Masters bid you do an Ill Thing, you must with modest Expostulations, rather Suffer than Obey.

items.text: Use all diligence and faithfulness in your master's business; be not slothful.
items.citation: Family Well-Ordered, Duties of Children to their Parents, CASE
items.quote: Servants, you must use all Diligence, and Faithfulness, in your Masters Business. A Slothful Servant is truly called a Wicked Servant.

items.text: Do not lie to your master; be a true man, lest you bring a curse on yourself.
items.citation: Family Well-Ordered, Duties of Children to their Parents, CASE
items.quote: Gehazi was a Servant that Lyed unto his Master; but God made that Lyar to become a Leper.

items.text: Do not steal or wrong your master even to a penny; if you have, repent and make restitution.
items.citation: Family Well-Ordered, Duties of Children to their Parents, CASE
items.quote: never venture to wrong your Masters unto the value of a Penny... make as much Restitution, and as full Reparation, as ever thou canst.

items.text: Contrive all ways to be a blessing in your master's house, as Joseph was.
items.citation: Family Well-Ordered, Duties of Children to their Parents, CASE
items.quote: Servant, Be such a Blessing in thy Masters House, as Joseph was to his.

items.text: If a servant will not obey, turn him out of doors.
items.citation: Family Well-Ordered, Duties of Children to their Parents, CASE
items.quote: If they will not obey you, Masters, Turn them out of Doors.

items.text: Never let lying in a servant go unpunished.
items.citation: Family Well-Ordered, Duties of Children to their Parents, CASE
items.quote: of all Faults in your Servants, I advise you, Masters, never to let that of Lying be unpunished.
